preconditions.description: T is a positive integer representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and isinstance(K, int) and 1 <= K <= N <= 10**5 for N, K in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N and K are integers satisfying 1 <= K <= N <= 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= 10**6 for x in A) for A in arrays)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the array A contains N integers between 1 and 10^6.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip().lower() in ['yes', 'no'] for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO' (case-insensitive).

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip().lower() == 'yes') == (can_make_palindrome(N, K, A)) for line, (N, K, A) in zip(stdout_lines, test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if and only if the array A can be made palindromic using the allowed operations, and 'NO' otherwise.
